svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.14.4.1 Type of Granular Material
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.14 DRAINAGE

g.text: Continuous layer of crushed stone or other
Not more than 10% of the material
No pyritic material in a concentration that
What the material may contain, Clauses (a) and (b)

svg.text: Granular material used to drain the bottom of
a foundation is a continuous layer of crushed
stone or other coarse clean granular material
(a) not more than 10% of material that will pass
a 4 mm sieve, and (b) no pyritic material in a
concentration that will damage the building to a
degree that would adversely affect its stability
Drawn: A a basement wall cut through. B a sieve over a pan, one way the 10% limit is checked.
